{{Actor|name=ovl_En_Syateki_Itm|ispage=true}}

'''ovl_En_Syateki_Itm''' is the [[actor]] for Hyrule's famous Shooting Gallery minigame. This actor spawns [[En_Syateki_Man]] behind the counter on the map, and contains information related to the movement of items within the minigame.

{{clear}}

== Shooting Gallery Moving Item Format ==

The movement of each item of the Shooting Gallery minigame follows the format: 3C0580B124A5xxxx0C01DF9026E4yyyy - where X is the start/end value, but Y is currently unknown. This format exists twice for each item since it records the start position and is written again for the end position.

{{clear}}
